contracts: failed-publication preserves live and durable lineage
foreign-session LRU publication blocks across durable commit
disk-quota rejection preserves live and durable lineage
restart preserves the committed post-delete checkpoint
surviving descendant remains usable with engine-defined ancestry payload semantics
engine_payload_semantics: DELETE removes response addressability and the session-key checkpoint rooted at the latest surviving session key; it does not claim cryptographic erasure of ancestor tokens retained in a surviving descendant checkpoint.
